setting: You are all in Bilbao, in the Basque Country, Spain, and you know each other through the swimming club your children train with. The group chat is for parents of kids on the same team, so you talk about training schedules, lifts to meets, and the odd bit of club news.
openers: Send a photo of the training schedule
Remind everyone about the swim cap order
Check who is bringing snacks to the meet

private_lines.Ane: You live in Bilbao with your partner and your two children, one of whom swims with the club. You teach at a primary school in the city, so your days are full of classes, marking and after-school duties, and evenings go to homework, dinner and the kids' training runs.
private_lines.Aitor: You live in Bilbao with your wife and your son, who swims with the club. You work as a clerk at the city council, so your days follow office hours, and evenings are spent on family meals, household jobs and getting your son to training.
private_lines.Laura: You live in Bilbao with your husband and your daughter, who swims with the club. You work as an accountant, so your days are busy with client files and deadlines, and evenings go to dinner, chores and driving your daughter to sessions.
private_lines.Alberto: You live in Bilbao with your wife and your two teenage children, one of whom swims with the club. You manage a bank branch in the city, so your days are busy with staff, customers and targets, and evenings go to family time and catching up on paperwork.

situation: Parents of kids on a swimming team.

text: Hey, saturday lift to barakaldo. Anyone can take the girls? My partner's on call and I can't do the 7:45 🙏
I can do the 7:45 if it's outbound only. Back is a problem for me
Warm up is 8:15 so need to leave by 7:45. Back after the 12 finish, one car for everyone if we can 😅
Saturday morning I'm on with my son in Bilbao, can't do outbound. I can do back, 12:30 if the finish is on time
Who has the pool address, is it the new one by the bridge or the old one
The new one 👍
Ok I'll take the 7:45 out. Need 3 spots
Who's on back with alberto? I might be on the 12:30 too, depends on a client file
So: Alberto out 7:45, Aitor back 12:30. Laura?
I can do back. Not doing 7:45 this time. Sofia and june are in the car
Fine by me. 12:30 at the front door
Ok I'll message the other parents for the 7:45 list. Need everyone's names
I'll send it tomorrow morning, today at school took ages. I'm done 😴
Perfect. Ane pls send the list before 9 so I can sort lunch for the girls

7:45 outbound list:
Alberto's car: Irati, Lucía, Mireia
Laura back: Sofia, June
Aitor back: Nerea, Pau
Got it. Leaving 7:30 in case the bridge is bad
Ty Ane 🙏 list is perfect. June's permission form still needs signing, ill do it before lunch
Front door at 12:30. Is the finish 12:00 or 12:15 with the cooldown?
12:00 finish, but they always run late. Text when you're out 👍
Mireia left her goggles case in the changing room. I have it in the boot. Who wants it, I can drop it Monday
Monday I'm at the club anyway for june's thing 😅 I'll take it
Ok
Random, has anyone had the club committee email about the christmas dinner? No date in mine, just "soon"
I think it's the 12th Dec. It was on the board by the desk on Thursday, I saw it when I dropped Pau
12th yes 👍 deposit due next friday. I'll put our names down
Ok paying for 2 then 😅
Fine. Put me down for one, my wife won't come
Saturday ok? Heard the 7:45 bridge was bad 😅
Fine. Left at 7:30 and still got there 8:05. Girls made the warm up
Back was on time. Pau got a pb in the 200 back, he's happy
Dinner deposit, I'll pay Ane direct for my 2 Monday at the club if that works?
Direct is fine 👍 deposit by next friday
Ok
Put me down for 2 as well. Wife and I
Yes 2 for you. Form goes out tomorrow
Random question, does anyone know if next Tuesday's session is still on with the pool closure? June's group got nothing in the email
Not on the board. Try Iker at the desk tomorrow
